composition.title_bias: bias title to the right half of the safe area
actions: Build separate background-title, subject, and foreground-title layers.
Let the subject or weapon cross only non-critical title strokes.
Use restrained shadow or glow to preserve readable depth.
composition.rationale: A visible subject and requested layering support text/subject interlocking.

typography.alignment: declared safe-area composition with explicit alignment lines
contrast_sequence: add restrained shadow/stroke/glow if still needed

notes: 人物和武器与标题做克制穿插

qa_checklist.text: Canvas matches the requested 3200x560, 1600x280, 600x200, or explicit custom dimensions.
Main title, subtitle, author, and any artwork attribution stay inside the declared safe-area rectangle.
Main title is concise, preserves article meaning, and is readable at 25% scale.
Every Chinese character is exact; no generated pseudo-glyphs, omissions, or substitutions remain.
Main title dominates subtitle, author, English decoration, and attribution.
Faces, weapons, actions, and other key subjects are not needlessly obscured.
One primary composition mode governs alignment, motion, layering, and decoration.
Every image, texture, illustration, and font has verified rights for the actual commercial or non-commercial context.
Attribution is accurate and placed where its license requires: artwork, metadata, or documentation.
